args.summary: Since this morning's deploy of v5.1.0, payments-api has been degraded across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate (~18%). Rolled back all production regions to the most recent previously healthy release, v5.0.0. On-call paged to investigate root cause of v5.1.0 errors.
args.title: payments-api v5.1.0 causing elevated errors — rolled back to v5.0.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Identified the service**: The service is named `payments-api` (not "payments"). It was running **v5.1.0**, unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

2. **Rolled back to the most recent healthy release**: The deployment history showed v5.0.0 was the last healthy release, so I rolled all three production regions back to **v5.0.0**. Verification confirms the service is now healthy with an error rate of just 0.2%.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created incident **INC-0001**, which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the v5.1.0 degradation, the ~18% error rate, and the rollback to v5.0.0.

Payments should now be functioning normally. The on-call engineer has been paged to investigate the root cause of the v5.1.0 errors.
